about: Descriptions for the 18 extra places on mapsma.com (/page5's answers only; data/places.json INFO pick: false), which had only a few words from facts.js (20 Nov 2026). Our words, neutral (the site lists them but does not recommend them), 60-140 characters, from each place's listing source and web search. Same fields as descriptions-2026-11-20.json.

places.name: Kan Bei
places.desc: Upscale Asian restaurant for Chinese and Thai dishes, à la carte or as a tasting menu, with a cocktail bar and terrace tables.
places.desc_es: Restaurante asiático de nivel con platillos chinos y tailandeses, a la carta o en menú de degustación, coctelería y mesas en terraza.
places.check: Site notes say rooftop; sources only confirm outdoor/terrace seating, not a rooftop. No Wanderlog page found; facts come from search summaries only.
facts: Listed as Asian / Chinese / Thai at Zacateros 14, between Pila Seca and Umarán
À la carte and tasting menus offered; MXN 500+ per person
Cocktail bar; tagged for outdoor/terrace dining
Diners mention spring rolls, pork belly and Beijing chicken
Open Tuesday to Sunday 13:00–22:00 (matches hours_week)

places.name: Ghar
places.desc: Indian restaurant in the leafy courtyard of the Casa Hoyos hotel: tandoor dishes, chicken tikka masala and vegetarian options.
places.desc_es: Restaurante indio en el patio lleno de plantas del hotel Casa Hoyos: platillos al tandoor, pollo tikka masala y opciones vegetarianas.
places.check: No Wanderlog page found; facts come from search summaries only. Booking status unclear (one site says it is not taking automatic reservations).
facts: In the outdoor courtyard of the boutique hotel Casa Hoyos, Mesones 14
Name means 'home' in Hindi; chef listed as Hiran Patel
Traditional tandoor oven; chicken tikka masala, aloo gobi, lamb chops
Wednesday to Sunday 14:00–21:30; about MXN 310–500

places.name: Carnitas El Güero
places.desc: Family-run taco spot across the road from the lookout on the Querétaro road: carnitas tacos and tortas, gorditas and fresh orange juice.
places.desc_es: Taquería familiar frente al mirador de la salida a Querétaro: tacos y tortas de carnitas, gorditas y jugo de naranja natural.
facts: Wanderlog lists it as "Carnitas" (taco restaurant); its summary names it Carnitas El Güero
Family-run; the mirador (lookout) is just across the road
Carnitas tacos, chicharrón, corn gorditas, beans, fresh orange juice; very low prices
Wanderlog hours Friday to Monday 09:00–17:00 (matches hours_week)

places.name: El Pato Barbacoa y Mixiotes
places.desc: Family-run barbacoa place, mornings only: slow-cooked lamb barbacoa with consommé, lamb mixiotes and handmade tortillas.
places.desc_es: Barbacoa familiar, solo por la mañana: barbacoa de borrego con consomé, mixiotes de borrego y tortillas hechas a mano.
places.check: Location: older guides and 2023 reviews put it on Calzada de la Estación near the bus station; Wanderlog now gives only 'Obraje' and a 2026 review mentions its 'current location' with parking, so it may have moved. Confirm the 'near Fábrica La Aurora' area.
facts: Run by a couple (Pilar and José Luis); open Wednesday to Sunday 08:00–14:00
Lamb barbacoa cooked all night, consommé from its juices, lamb mixiotes
Build-your-own tacos with thin handmade tortillas and salsas; flan
Simple tent-like dining area

places.name: Mariscos Los Delfines
places.desc: Seafood counter with stools inside the Ignacio Ramírez market: shrimp cocktails with saltines, octopus quesadillas and tostadas.
places.desc_es: Barra de mariscos con bancos dentro del mercado Ignacio Ramírez: cócteles de camarón con galletas saladas, quesadillas de pulpo y tostadas.
facts: Inside the Mercado Ignacio Ramírez (Wanderlog tip: look for it inside the market, not by the map pin)
Shrimp cocktail with saltines, octopus quesadillas, shrimp tostadas
Also known for caldo de pollo
Daily 09:00–16:30; low prices

places.name: El Puerto Seafood
places.desc: Seafood restaurant and bar on Canal: tuna ceviche, peeled shrimp, mixed fish soup and whole fish in garlic, with a shrimp broth to start.
places.desc_es: Restaurante y bar de mariscos en Canal: ceviche de atún, camarones pelados, caldo de pescado mixto y pescado entero al mojo de ajo.
places.check: There is also an El Puerto Seafood at San Pedro 14 (OpenTable, Discover SMA); a reviewer describes the Canal venue as a second place around the corner. Check this row is the intended one.
facts: Listed on Wanderlog as El Puerto Seafood SMA Restaurante Bar, Canal 94
Tuna ceviche, peeled shrimp, mixed fish soup, whole garlic fish; shrimp broth served as a starter
Wanderlog hours closed Tuesday, otherwise 09:00–20:00 (matches hours_week)

places.name: Mercado Ignacio Ramírez
places.desc: Covered town market with produce, crafts and food stalls: tortas, enchiladas, tamales, comida corrida and fresh juices.
places.desc_es: Mercado techado con frutas, verduras, artesanías y puestos de comida: tortas, enchiladas, tamales, comida corrida y jugos naturales.
facts: Big market on Colegio, north-east edge of Centro, next to the crafts market
Fruit, vegetables, butchers, tortillas, souvenirs and crafts
Food stalls with tortas, enchiladas, tamales, fresh juices; inexpensive
Wanderlog hours daily 07:00–17:00; food stalls about 09:00–17:00

places.name: Petit Four
places.desc: Pastry shop and café up a flight of stairs, with a small courtyard: quiche, baked eggs, chilaquiles, cakes and French pastries. Cash only.
places.desc_es: Pastelería y café subiendo unas escaleras, con un pequeño patio: quiche, huevos al horno, chilaquiles, pasteles y repostería francesa. Solo efectivo.
facts: Café and pastry shop on Jesús, just off the Jardín; reached up a flight of stairs; courtyard tables
Pastries, cakes, pain au chocolat, almond croissants; breakfast and lunch menu
Baked eggs in tomato sauce with poblano, quiche, chilaquiles
Cash only (several reviews, latest 2026); chef Paco Cárdenas also gives cooking classes

places.name: Café Rama
places.desc: Eclectic café with local art on the walls: all-day breakfast (huevos rancheros, eggs florentine), house cakes and live music some evenings.
places.desc_es: Café ecléctico con arte local: desayunos todo el día (huevos rancheros, huevos florentinos), pasteles caseros y música en vivo algunas noches.
facts: Bohemian café-restaurant with mismatched furniture and art for sale
Breakfast/brunch: huevos rancheros, eggs florentine, chilaquiles; baguette with homemade jam
House cakes (German chocolate, carrot, apple pie); bar; fish tacos and enchiladas at lunch
Live music on some evenings and weekends (jazz, Cuban and others)

places.name: Churrería San Agustín
places.desc: Busy traditional café for churros, plain or filled with cajeta or condensed milk, and hot chocolate in several styles. Expect a queue.
places.desc_es: Café tradicional muy concurrido de churros, solos o rellenos de cajeta o lechera, y chocolate caliente de varios estilos. Suele haber fila.
facts: Listed as Chocolates y Churros San Agustín, San Francisco 21
Churros plain or filled (cajeta, condensed milk); several hot chocolates; breakfast dishes
Often a waiting list or queue, especially weekends
Daily 08:00–22:00; Wanderlog tip says cash only

places.name: Panadería La Buena Vida
places.desc: Small takeaway bakery: orange-glazed doughnuts, cinnamon rolls, sweet and savoury empanadas, muffins and bread. Go early.
places.desc_es: Pequeña panadería para llevar: donas glaseadas de naranja, roles de canela, empanadas dulces y saladas, muffins y pan. Ve temprano.
facts: Bakery at Hernández Macías 72, tucked at the back; no seating
Orange-glazed doughnuts, cinnamon rolls, potato-and-cheese empanadas, bran muffins, scones, rosemary ciabatta, seeded bread
Some breads sell out, so go early
Monday to Saturday 08:00–15:00 (matches hours_week)

places.name: Áperi
places.desc: Fine-dining restaurant with a five-course tasting menu that changes with the market, wine pairings and a chef's table facing the kitchen.
places.desc_es: Restaurante de alta cocina con menú de degustación de cinco tiempos que cambia según el mercado, maridaje de vinos y mesa del chef frente a la cocina.
places.check: Sources name different chefs (Jesús Vázquez; Olivier Deboise as the newer chef), so the kitchen may have changed hands; some listings give Quebrada 99.
facts: Creative fine dining at Quebrada 101; reservations advised
Five-course tasting menu that changes with available produce; wine pairings incl. Mexican wines; à la carte too
Chef's table in an indoor courtyard with a view into the kitchen; outdoor seating
Closed Tuesday (matches hours_week)

places.name: Quince Rooftop
places.desc: Multi-level rooftop bar and restaurant beside the Parroquia: international menu with sushi and ceviches, cocktails, DJs or shows at night.
places.desc_es: Bar y restaurante en azotea de varios niveles junto a la Parroquia: menú internacional con sushi y ceviches, coctelería y DJ o espectáculos de noche.
places.check: Hours differ: Wanderlog shows Sat–Mon from 10:00 and Tue–Fri from 15:00, closing 22:30–23:30; hours_week has Mon–Fri from 13:00 and weekends from 09:30.
facts: Cuna de Allende 15, next to the Parroquia; views of the church and of sunset
Eclectic international menu: sushi, ceviche, aguachile, steak; extensive drinks list
DJs and live entertainment in the evenings; reservations recommended for a view table

places.name: Fátima 7 Rooftop
places.desc: Rooftop restaurant of the Hotel Casa Blanca 7, with views of the Parroquia: Mexican cooking with Mediterranean touches, breakfast to dinner.
places.desc_es: Restaurante en la azotea del hotel Casa Blanca 7, con vista a la Parroquia: cocina mexicana con toques mediterráneos, del desayuno a la cena.
places.check: OpenTable (search summary) lists Tuesday to Sunday only; Wanderlog and hours_week show daily.
facts: On the roof of the boutique Hotel Casa Blanca 7, Juárez 7
Views of the Parroquia and a neighbouring church; heaters at night
Mexican cooking with Mediterranean/Moroccan and other global touches: corn croquettes, burrata, octopus, pizza, hummus
Wine pairing suggested for each dish; serves breakfast

places.name: Terraza La Vista
places.desc: Rooftop restaurant of the El Golpe de Vista hotel, with wide views over the town at sunset; contemporary Mexican cooking.
places.desc_es: Restaurante en la azotea del hotel El Golpe de Vista, con amplia vista de la ciudad al atardecer; cocina mexicana contemporánea.
places.check: Chiles en nogada (site notes) not confirmed by any source; it is a seasonal dish, so it was left out of the description.
facts: Rooftop (third floor) of the boutique hotel El Golpe de Vista, Prolongación de Aldama 1
Listed as contemporary Mexican; diners mention tasting menus
Panoramic views over San Miguel are the main draw
Hours Tue–Wed 13:00–21:00, Thu–Sat 13:00–22:00, Sun 09:00–17:00 (matches hours_week)

places.name: Bennu
places.desc: Wood-fired sourdough pizza in a courtyard with no sign outside, plus vegetable starters such as jícama aguachile, and cocktails.
places.desc_es: Pizza de masa madre al horno de leña en un patio sin letrero afuera, con entradas de verduras como aguachile de jícama, y cócteles.
facts: Neapolitan-style sourdough pizza, dough fermented over 24 h; pizza of the day; Bestia and marinara pizzas
Vegetable-focused starters: jícama aguachile, cauliflower, corn, mango salad
Courtyard setting; no sign at the door; small menu; cocktails and Mexican wines
Wed–Sat 13:00–21:30, Sun 12:00–20:30 (matches hours_week)

places.name: Tío Lucas
places.desc: Restaurant-bar for steaks and Mexican and international dishes, a Caesar salad made at the table, and live jazz, blues or salsa most nights.
places.desc_es: Restaurante bar de cortes y platillos mexicanos e internacionales, ensalada César preparada en la mesa y jazz, blues o salsa en vivo casi a diario.
places.check: hours_week has no Saturday entry; Wanderlog shows Saturday 13:00–23:30 and opening at 13:00 (not 13:30) every day.
facts: Mesones 103; restaurant-bar with arches and Mexican decor
Steaks (fillet, ribeye, medallions), seafood, Caesar salad and tuna tartare prepared at the table
Live music most nights: jazz, blues, salsa, Cuban
Long tequila list and wine list

places.name: Panadería La Colmena
places.desc: Traditional Mexican bakery behind a blue door, open since 1901: conchas (some cream-filled), empanadas, campechanas and polvorones.
places.desc_es: Panadería mexicana tradicional tras una puerta azul, abierta desde 1901: conchas (algunas rellenas de crema), empanadas, campechanas y polvorones.
places.check: hours_week is empty and sources conflict: Wanderlog shows roughly 06:00–21:00 Monday to Saturday (odd Sunday 06:00–09:00); other guides say weekdays 07:00–17:00 or 07:00–19:00, closed weekends.
facts: Relox 21; founded 1901 by Florentino Rayas, considered the oldest bakery in town; city plaque in 2021
Nicknamed 'the blue door bakery'; grab-and-go, low prices
Conchas (vanilla custard-filled ones), empanadas, shortbread-style cookies; items sell out, go early
